label: Television

questions.text: How many hours a day is the TV on?
questions.why: Long daily use wears the panel and backlight.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Is it plugged into a surge protector or stabilizer?

questions.why: A firm mount or stand prevents falls that break the panel.

questions.text: Is there space around the back and sides of the TV?
questions.why: A television needs air around it to stay cool.

answers.label: It is in a tight cabinet

questions.text: Are there small children or pets near the TV?
questions.why: Bumps and pulled cables are a common cause of broken panels.

questions.text: Have you noticed lines on the screen, flicker or no sound?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the TV before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the TV yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Plug the TV into a surge protector, and unplug it during lightning storms.
care_tips.why: Power surges are a common cause of TV failures.

care_tips.text: Clean the screen with a soft dry cloth and no sprays or strong cleaners.
care_tips.why: Liquids and chemicals can damage the screen coating.

care_tips.text: Make sure the TV is firmly mounted or on a stable stand.
care_tips.why: A fall can break the panel.

care_tips.text: Leave space around the TV for air to flow.
care_tips.why: Heat shortens the life of the electronics.

care_tips.text: If lines, patches, flicker or sound problems appear, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Early checks can find faults while the warranty applies.

reminders.text: Dust the TV's vents and the area around it (switched off and unplugged).
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
